title: Tunisian Nutty Velvety Brunch
description: A comforting and flavorful brunch dish from Tunisia, featuring a nutty and velvety texture.

ingredients.name: ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: sticks of cinnamon may be used instead

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together pistachio flour, almond milk, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Add in the unsweetened almond butter and whisk until fully incorporated.
In a separate pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the grated carrot and cook for about 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the crushed almonds and ground cinnamon to the pan and cook for another minute.
In a small saucepan, melt the honey over low heat.
In a separate bowl, whip the beurre monte until it becomes stiff and holds its shape.
Fold the whipped beurre monte into the almond milk mixture until fully incorporated.
Add the cooked carrot mixture to the almond milk mixture and fold until combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving dishes or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Garnish with cinnamon sticks or chopped nuts, if desired.
